prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object approached, then grab it, check properties, move to destination, do specific task. Else approach or scan area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO MoveToDestination
		DO SpecificTask
	END
